title: Weighted $L^2$ theory for the Euclidean Dirac operator in higher dimensions
summary: We study weighted $L^{2}$ solvability for the Euclidean Dirac operator in dimensions $n\ge 3$. We prove that, on the exterior domain $\mathbb{R}^{n}\setminus\overline{B(0,1)}$ with logarithmic weight $\varphi=n\log|x|$, no higher-dimensional analogue of the two-dimensional Hörmander estimate can be controlled solely by $Δ\varphi$; we then establish weighted solvability for the weights $|x|^{m}$ with $m\neq 0$, for the quadratic weight $x_{1}^{2}$, and for sufficiently small anisotropic perturbations of the Gaussian weight, with sharp constant $1/4$ in the Gaussian case.
